Use case: precise-object-edit. Production raster pixel terrain background, 1536x1024.
Input image1 is selected concept STYLE reference ONLY. Image2 is current SUMMER TERRAIN EDIT TARGET. Improve terrain richness while keeping image2's exact central sand oval geometry x15.5–84%, y74–91% and central path x46–54% down to bottom, water only extreme x0–3%, empty walkable region y50–94%. SUMMER.
Replace uniform low hedge in target with the CONCEPT's rich layered forest: large overlapping broadleaf tree canopies with distinct height variation, beginning as high as y27% near sides/right and staggered depths through y49%. Taller broadleaf edge trees and lower middle clusters, visible trunks only within distant forest. Forest must be behind walking region, never below y50%. Hills remain hazy layered sage behind them. Upper-left x0–47%, y0–28% remains quiet mint sky #b4e3db for headings.
Add narrow pale sandy connecting paths (4% of canvaswidth), original charming pixel contours: from cottage future position x22%,y58% curve right/down to join plaza left at x30%,y80%; from shop future x82%,y58% curve left/down to join plaza right at x73%,y80%; from future cabin x91%,y74% short leftward branch merging with right connecting path near x79%,y76%. PATHS ONLY: endpoints empty land, do not draw buildings. Sand same #ead4a0 as existing plaza.
Keep broad sunny green walkable meadow #8bb56e but enrich with little tiny grass clusters. A few small white daisies and modest shrub clusters ONLY by far left/right edges outside x8–92%; nothing blocking center. Small cropped wooden bridges stay at outermost edges.
Crisp deliberate chunky pixel-art clusters 2–4px, original hand-crafted retro pastoral RPG artwork, lively and warm like concept. No smooth gradients/photorealistic rendering. ABSOLUTELY NO houses, buildings, central tree, foreground tree, characters/people/animals, signs, furniture, benches, lamps, fences, logo/well, typography, UI, border, watermark. Those objects are real separate source assets. Opaque. Do not reproduce reference screenshot; edit only target terrain per instructions.
